findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Long-lived unrotated key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and conflicts with common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy attribute is defined, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy that grants the full account root principal kms:* on the key, allowing any IAM principal in the account that can be granted access to use or administer the key protecting audit logs. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict administration and usage to specific roles.
